game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart, the glowing heart of the ruins: the rune scholar must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Stat Market: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart: the glowing heart of the ruins
core_gameplay_loop: In Eldritch Heart, repeat each round: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the crypt seal using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the crypt seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Stat Market
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stat Market' (Week 7 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Eldritch Heart'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Eldritch Heart.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 16.
